_doc: tools/import_frames.gd: Tide's in-match side view from the AI-made run cycle (frame_1..8.png, 1280x720, facing right, transparent) and the ready pose (poses.ready: ../side_ready/ready_v1.png, 887x1792, kneeling, fists together on the chest, no gun, green backdrop; the AI sparkle over the front boot's toe un-blended out of it before it was saved here). Source px unless noted. height: 64 world px for her 592 px run figure (0.108 world px per source px, the roster's 0.113 x 0.96: her head drawn as big as Flora's in the run frames, her legs longer; any taller and she towers over the others); idle: the standing picture ../side_idle/idle_v1.png (poses.stand); walk 12 fps: the planted foot moves back ~7.7 world px a frame (90 px/s walk); canvas pinned (a standing picture that fits leaves the run frames' PNGs as they are). See assets/README.md.

restoreWhites._doc: the run frames were cut from the video's white backdrop by a global white key (media-edit ani.py: every px over 240 cleared, her eye whites and the white of her boots and shorts too, their colour kept under alpha 0): the enclosed holes not of the backdrop's (252, 252, 252) made opaque again; the gaps of backdrop between an arm or a leg and the body stay clear

idle._doc: the standing picture (poses.stand, ../side_idle/idle_v1.png); without it the run frame 0 (frame_1.png)

draw._doc: the ready pose, shown at once while the gun is out (gunDraw: no transition)

fire._doc: the shot from the ready pose: its frame with the recoil (the hugged gun kicks back along its axis by the flash)

gun._doc: angle per frame is added to the hold (+ = muzzle down). The gun is holstered in idle / walk in the match; carry: where it would be held (px from the feet pivot, source px). fists (optional, Rookie's config): the near fist per source frame, to sway the gun with the arm.

gunDraw._doc: gun_draw.gd TIMINGS overrides: the ready pose switches in and out at once

stand._doc: pose px (298x735): standing upright, facing right, the tank on her back, transparent (cut from the middle figure of an AI picture whose backdrop is white on the left and green on the right: both keyed, the white by a flood from outside so her white shirt / shorts / boots stay, the green pockets between the hair, the tank and the legs too; no sparkle on it), then cleaned like the run frames. scale: source px per pose px (the face from the ear to the nose as wide as in the run frames: 117 / 130 px; the figure then as tall as frame_1); alignX: the middle of the face (ear .. nose) on frame_1's, so the head does not jump idle <-> walk <-> ready.

ready._doc: pose px (887x1792): kneeling, facing right, both fists together in front of the chest, NO gun, the water tank on her back, on a flat green backdrop (keyed out: `background`, holeMin / holePure / spillFrom keyed). scale: source px per pose px (the face from the ear to the nose as wide as in the run frames: 117 / 319 px); alignX: the middle of the face (ear .. nose) on frame_1's, so the head does not jump on the switch. The hug gun is placed in `scene` (its GunSocket on the fists: the gun turns round it).

gun._doc: the fallback seat (no scene): the hug point, the middle of the two fists (pose px), level

armFront._doc: the near arm drawn OVER the hugged gun (assets/characters/tide/side/ready_arm_front.png, same canvas as ready_0), pose px: polygon round the near sleeve (from the shoulder), the forearm and the NEAR fist only (its right edge at the outline between the two fists, x 716); seeds: one point inside each piece the outline walls in. The far fist (x 716..815) and the far forearm under it stay in the body, under the gun: only one hand is seen holding it, as Rookie's / Flora's / Spark's / Tanko's. See Rookie's config for the keys.
